Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) has launched a new research platform dedicated to quantum error correction, aimed at improving the reliability of qubit operations in quantum computing systems. The platform equips researchers and developers with tools for testing and deploying error‑mitigation strategies, supporting AMD’s broader push into emerging quantum technologies. This initiative underscores the industry’s growing focus on addressing hardware challenges central to practical quantum computing.
